items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Teddy and Roy Eldridge, oh -- ... I think he did a couple of woodwind things with Teddy and Roy Eldridge

ctx.x: Those were kind of happy days. There was no jazz in New York in those early days. Forest Hills was really a -- a Sunday afternoon was really the hub of all good playing, Teddy used to come and Benny and Joe Venuti, oh --
Oh, she loved Joe, didn't she?
